On the flip side, the human ones had more personality - sometimes there would be sarcasm, little grammar mistakes, emojis, or just a kind of randomness that felt more real. Even if they weren't perfectly written, they had more flavor. I found myself thinking, OK, this one sounds like someone who just opened Twitter and started typing what's on their mind. That messy authenticity made it easier to tell, even if I wasn't 100 percent sure every time.
